name: ingeotec
description: Claude Code plugins by INGEOTEC. Currently: issue-pilot, unattended, dependency-aware implementation of issues, with or without GitHub.

plugins.name: issue-pilot
plugins.description: Turn a list of issues into one reviewed branch, unattended — on GitHub (issues and a pull request) or without it (markdown issues in the repository, merged or pushed your way): a deterministic plan decides when the conversation is cleared, on-disk state survives it, and a usage guard keeps the run inside your 5-hour and weekly windows.
